description: Configure here, how the module should behave

content.name: admins
content.description: Users who can perform admin only actions e.g. manage the balance of users (Bot Operators always have this permission)

content.name: allowCheats
content.description: Allow admins to edit the balance of users (for a fair system not recommended!)

content.name: selfBalance
content.description: Allow admins to edit their own balance (for a fair system not recommended! DON'T DO THIS!!!!!)

content.name: shopManagers
content.description: The Ids of the shop managers (Bot Operators have this permission always)

content.name: startMoney
content.description: The amount of money that is given to a new user

content.name: currencyName
content.description: The name of the currency

content.name: currencySymbol
content.description: The symbol of the currency

content.name: maxWorkMoney
content.description: The highest amount of money you can get for working

content.name: minWorkMoney
content.description: The lowest amount of money you can get for working

content.name: workCooldown
content.description: The amount of time a user needs to wait util they can use the work command again (in minutes)

content.name: maxCrimeMoney
content.description: The highest amount of money you can get for crime

content.name: minCrimeMoney
content.description: The lowest amount of money you can get for crime

content.name: crimeCooldown
content.description: The amount of time a user needs to wait util they can use the crime command again (in minutes)

content.name: maxRobAmount
content.description: The highest amount of money that a user can rob

content.name: robPercent
content.description: The amount that can get robed in percent

content.name: robCooldown
content.description: The amount of time a user needs to wait util they can use the rob command again (in minutes)

content.name: leaderboardChannel
content.description: The channel for the leaderboard. On this leaderboard everyone can see who has the most money.

content.name: shopChannel
content.description: The id of the channel for the shop-Message. This message shows the items of the shop

content.name: msgDropsIgnoredChannels
content.description: List of Channels where Users can't get message-drops

content.name: messageDrops
content.description: Chance to get money for a message (Chance: 1/ This value). Set to 0 to disable message drops

content.name: messageDropsMax
content.description: The max amount of money in a message Drop

content.name: messageDropsMin
content.description: The min amount of money in a message Drop

content.name: dailyReward
content.description: The daily reward

content.name: weeklyReward
content.description: The weekly reward

content.name: publicCommandReplies
content.description: Should the Command-replies be displayed for everyone?
